title: פונ[?]
notes: A curly brace on the card groups ג'ינג'ר, קינמון and לימון together with 'לפי הטעם' (to taste) written beside it.
Ginger is written roughly as 'גנג'ר' on the card; normalized here to ג'ינג'ר.
A signature or flourish at the bottom of the card.

uncertainties.reason: First three letters (פ-ו-נ) are clear; the last one or two cramped glyphs (a 'C' shape and a looped stroke) do not clearly form ש. 'פונש' (punch) fits the content (wine, cognac, boiled and served hot).

Two words after 'מים' are unclear. First looks like ה/ב + א + ו + an open 'U' glyph + ן followed by a comma; second starts 'במו' (or 'כמו') and ends in a stroke trailing into a long line. No confident reading.
Quantity is a single small 'y'-like mark with a dot above; not written like the clear 1/2 on the lemon line. Could be 1/2 or a 4.
Word after ginger (about four letters, ending in ר or כ, an open 'U' glyph in the middle) is unclear. Previous reading 'ביר' is not supported by the letter count.
